annotations.title: Turn auto-merge on or off for one mission

description: Set whether SHIP merges this mission's pull request by itself once the checks, the review and the test pass. The setting is for this mission only and replaces the project's auto-merge for it; get_project shows the project's. While it is on, SHIP merges without asking again. Requires the missions:write scope.

enabled.description: true merges the pull request once it is ready; false leaves the merge to a person

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-412

name: set_mission_auto_merge
